description: Information system does not protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for unencrypted network communications, lack of TLS/SSL implementation, use of deprecated or weak encryption protocols, no cryptographic protection for data in transit, missing encryption for external and internal network transmissions, and absence of integrity verification mechanisms for transmitted data.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - System and Communications Protection
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
